first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing makes the price-sensitive SMB acquisition risk immediate, while the inherited pricing result claims both acquisition and revenue lift but does not establish durable post-promotion value. Verify that consequential evidence first, alongside onboarding evidence because completion is also declining. Pending verification, run only a tightly targeted, margin- and retention-instrumented SMB pricing test rather than a broad discount rollout.

final.rationale: Run an SMB-only signup/onboarding simplification experiment. The verified record shows a durable-relevant improvement in activation (+9%) and qualified revenue (+4%) with only a small 30-day retention decrease (-1%), directly addressing the concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation. Do not use promotional pricing: its apparent revenue lift came with materially worse 30-day retention (-12%), conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Instrument completion, first meaningful action, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention; do not generalize results beyond SMB.
